review_method: Parent labeled native-size inspection of all sixteen final pajama poses.

directions.evidence: Chin raised and nose points upward; irises sit high under upper lids.
Chin lifted with slightly rightward nose and right-shifted irises; neck exposed.
Face yaws right while chin remains lifted; irises look toward upper-right.
Nose and irises aim screen-right with chin still tilted above horizontal; upward eyelid cue remains.
Nose points right, iris position rightward and side-facing cheek confirms horizontal right.
Face aims right but chin starts dropping; upper lids lower and pupils aim below horizontal.
Rightward nose with tucked chin and lowered eyes makes both axes visible.
Mostly tucked downward head, with nose and visible iris still slightly screen-right.
Chin tucked centrally toward chest; eyelids lowered with nose aimed below face center.
Chin tucked and nose shifts slightly left; eyes point lower-left.
Nose and face clearly leftward with down pitch and lowered lids.
Head yaw screen-left with small downward chin angle; irises left and low.
Nose points left, both irises shift left and opposite cheek occlusion confirms yaw.
Face yaws left with chin beginning to lift; pupils point left and above horizontal.
Chin visibly raised and nose yaw left; upper-left iris alignment.
Head mostly raised with a small remaining leftward yaw and upper-left eyes; coherent next-up transition.
